error: Independent requirement audit rejected this test/reference: {"approved": false, "coverage": "partial", "issues": ["The error-display snapshots impose an unspecified persistence duration. For example, item1_empty_error requires -1 at 2800ms, 300ms after confirmation release, although the public response deadline is 250ms and no minimum error-display duration is specified. A conforming implementation could display -1 promptly, then resume the selected item/price before that snapshot. The same issue affects the other post-rejection display snapshots. Check that -1 is presented within the authorized response window without requiring an unspecified hold, or supply an explicit error-hold requirement."], "coverage_gaps": ["The one-second item/price alternation is not distinguishable with the supplied equal item-number and price values. The reference implements the logical alternation, but the observations cannot establish it.", "Sale-beep checks establish only GPIO activity, not a valid audible carrier or the required 100ms duration. The required out-of-stock audible alarm is not checked; its unspecified frequency and cadence do not make the alarm itself optional.", "Both D7 holds last 2500ms, and restocking starts only after release. The suite does not establish transition at the 2000ms threshold, rejection of premature transitions, or recognition of admin mode while D7 remains held.", "Restocking occurs only after stock has reached zero. These cases cannot distinguish adding stock from replacing stock. The 9999 stock bound and upper payload boundary are also untested.", "Only newline-terminated named commands are exercised. The required idle-terminated framing with a 20ms timeout is not exercised.", "There is no stocked-item check forbidding dispensing on D7 press before its short release, or checking sale behavior for a hold just below the long-press threshold."], "reason": "The pin mapping, active-LOW pull-up inputs, named serial transport, baud rate, initial stock, and accepted-sale messages are consistent with the supplied requirement. The reference logically implements selection, inventory decrement, bounded additive restocking, admin toggling, idle framing, and the specified sale beep; its persistent error display is a permissible implementation choice, not a requirement. The proposed suite is substantially useful but cannot be approved as written because its error snapshots can reject another conforming display policy. Its explicitly partial coverage also omits several required dynamic behaviors."}
